noise_scope: Fixed empirical C_alpha defines a deterministic discrepancy, not a calibrated confidence region or exact joint Poisson likelihood. C is not modelled as an additional geometry-dependent random observation.
target_scope: Geometry-dependent minimum-energy quadratic-moment operator on the fixed selected nodes; not a lower bound for every continuum estimator or the full causal-set observation.
pair_scope: Same selected-node order and density/scale/node labels; no proof of indistinguishability of the entire original A/B poset or joint overlap distribution.
stop_rule: Run every listed source once; four fixed signed search objectives per qualified base; no adaptive replacement, budget extension or tuning. Select first source by index with a passing rounded pair, then largest relative separation among its prescribed trials. Failed search is not a stability proof.
